I'm **Fiona Burlig**, an assistant professor at the Harris School of Public Policy at the University of Chicago. I am an applied microeconomist working at the intersection of energy, environmental, and resource economics, development economics, and agricultural economics.

<p class="meta">Faculty Research Fellow, <a href="https://www.nber.org">NBER</a> (EEE and DEV) · Affiliate, <a href="https://www.povertyactionlab.org">J-PAL</a>, <a href="https://ibread.org">BREAD</a>, and <a href="https://www.theigc.org">IGC</a> · Deputy Faculty Director, <a href="https://epic.uchicago.in">EPIC-India</a> and the Odisha Data, Policy, and Innovation Centre</p>
